_about: The first night each rule was live on the board (not the day it was decided), by test id. The Friday tests on both sides read it: a test shows 'since the rule went in' from this night and 'season'; a rule without a date shows season only. Add an entry the same day a rule is adopted. 'windows' where a window started later: the 2026-11-13 button went live after that morning's lock, so its morning reads start 11-14.

_schema.windows: optional {am, pm}: first night live per window

elite-cut.what: Elites: the top of T1 cut at the biggest projection gap among its top 3-4 (1 to 3)

t2-pm-elite-break.what: T2 afternoon: ADP with ETR within 2 picks up to pick X, ETR from X (X = 13/9 minus the elites)

t34-am-adp-groups.what: T3/T4 morning: VALUE, rest, PRICEY, each by ADP

t34-pm-etr-groups.what: T3/T4 afternoon: VALUE, rest, PRICEY, each by ETR (ADP, then Boom, on exact ties)

t3-pricey-over-t4-value.what: T3 PRICEY stays ahead of T4 VALUE

t4-pricey-to-t5.what: T4 PRICEY players drop into T5, right after its top 3, exempt from the drafted% line (from 2026-11-13 PM)

t4-ends-round6.what: T4 ends at the start of round 6, earlier at an ADP gap of 2+ picks just before it; round 6 never in T4 on the ADP ladder (the one-tier move can still lift an A5 player into T4: t4-value-from-a5)

t4-borrow-t3.what: T4 short of 4 borrows from the bottom of T3

t5-drafted-60.what: T5: drafted under 60% of pods (50-60% at the bottom) by projection; 60%+ out of T5. 4-drafter nights: no line, T5 by projection (t5-4drafter-no-line)

t5-minutes-floor.what: T5: projected 20+ minutes only (box-score minutes in the morning, ETR-implied in the afternoon)

t5-ends-at-cut.what: T5 ends at the ranked cut; everyone else below it by projection

q-keeps-tier.what: Questionable at the lock: keeps his tier in both windows (afternoon two-tiers-back retired)

q-t1-to-t2.what: A Questionable player in T1 drops to the top of T2

q-adp-fall.what: A Questionable player whose ADP fell 6+ picks since the tag goes below the cut (tagged from the slate's open: since his ADP on the last earlier slate where he was untagged, from 2026-11-13 PM)

q-teammate-tiebreak.what: A T1-T4 teammate of a Questionable player gets the tiebreak within his group

q-t5-follows-t5.what: T5 Questionable players follow T5's rule

swap-button.what: The Swap button: T5 and below by the latest projection after the last draft, its own swap lock

gallagher-bad-arrow.what: Down arrow on Gallagher's Bad matchups (column days, write-ups before the lock)

proj-box-3-days.what: Morning Proj: box scores count as 3 days of ETR, their minutes halfway to the last 3 games

proj-fresh-absence.what: Morning Proj: a teammate out a first or second night moves teammates 1.5x the table

t5-4drafter-no-line.what: 4-drafter nights: no drafted% line; T5 by projection, marked on the board, until a Friday shows a line that works

t4-value-from-a5.what: Rule order fixed: ADP ladder, then the one-tier move toward the projection (A5-P3 or better is T4 VALUE), then the T5 rules (drafted% line, minutes floor, below the cut) only on the final T5. Before, every A5 player was forced back to T5 (25 primary rows this season sent below the cut)
